stories.title: Hannah and the Birth of Samuel
stories.summary: Barren Hannah prays at Shiloh and vows to dedicate a son to the LORD. She bears Samuel, brings him to Eli, and sings a song of thanksgiving.

stories.title: Eli's Sons and Samuel's Call
stories.summary: Eli's sons abuse their priestly office, and a man of God announces judgment on Eli's house. The LORD calls the boy Samuel by night and confirms him as a prophet.

stories.title: The Ark Captured and Returned
stories.summary: Israel loses the ark to the Philistines at Aphek, and Eli and his sons die. The ark brings plagues on Philistine cities and is sent back on a cart to Beth-shemesh and Kiriath-jearim.

stories.title: Samuel Judges Israel
stories.summary: Samuel calls Israel to put away foreign gods, and the LORD thunders against the Philistines at Mizpah. The stone Ebenezer marks the victory.

stories.title: Israel Demands a King
stories.summary: The elders ask Samuel for a king. Saul of Benjamin is anointed, chosen by lot, and confirmed after defeating the Ammonites at Jabesh-gilead; Samuel gives a farewell address.

stories.title: Saul Rejected
stories.summary: Saul offers sacrifice before Samuel arrives and later spares King Agag and the best of the Amalekite livestock. Samuel tells him the kingdom will be taken from him.

stories.title: David Anointed
stories.summary: Samuel anoints David, the youngest son of Jesse, at Bethlehem. David joins Saul's court to play the lyre when an evil spirit troubles the king.

stories.title: David and Goliath
stories.summary: The Philistine champion Goliath challenges Israel for forty days. David, armed with a sling and five stones, kills him in the name of the LORD.

stories.title: Saul's Jealousy and David's Flight
stories.summary: Jonathan makes a covenant with David, Saul grows jealous of his success and tries to kill him, and David escapes with help from Michal, Jonathan and the priest Ahimelech.

stories.title: David in the Wilderness
stories.summary: David gathers followers at Adullam, Saul has the priests of Nob killed, and David spares Saul's life in a cave at En-gedi and in the camp at Ziph. Abigail intervenes to keep David from killing her husband Nabal.

stories.title: Saul and the Medium at Endor; Saul's Death
stories.summary: Saul consults a medium at Endor and is told he will die. David is dismissed from the Philistine army and defeats the Amalekites at Ziklag; Saul and his sons die on Mount Gilboa.
